top.name: Binding Chains
top.rules_text: Name an enemy for 2 turns: if it attacks, the attack deals half damage and it takes 3. Gain 1 Weave.

bottom.name: Drain Glyph
bottom.rules_text: Prepare a glyph within 4. When an enemy enters: deal 5 damage and heal you 5 HP.

upgrades.description: Heavy Chains: the Naming lasts 3 turns.

changes.value: Name an enemy for 3 turns: if it attacks, the attack deals half damage and it takes 5. Gain 1 Weave.

upgrades.description: Chains of the Seventh Layer: Name the target and the nearest other enemy.

changes.value: Name an enemy for 3 turns, and the nearest other enemy within 3 for 2: if it attacks, the attack deals half damage and it takes 5. Gain 1 Weave.

upgrades.description: Vampiric Glyph: also weakens the victim.

upgrades.description: Eternal Bondage: the Naming is permanent for this combat.

changes.value: Name an enemy for the rest of the fight: if it attacks, the attack deals half damage and it takes 7. Gain 2 Weave.

upgrades.description: Soul Cage: a reusable trap that Names and drains.

changes.value: Prepare a reusable glyph. Each enemy entering takes 9, is Named for 1 turn, and heals you 9 HP.
